title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon Lorehold student and planeswalker historian who returns to Strixhaven to research the Coin Empire and finds an artifact cache in the Fields of Strife.

entities.name: Dean Augusta Tullus
entities.description: Lorehold's dean of order, who died defending her school and now teaches as a stone-formed ghost.

entities.name: Ketu
entities.description: The young owlin secretary of Dean Tullus who greets Quint.

entities.name: Mica
entities.description: A buff human geomancer undergraduate of Lorehold who accompanies Quint and finds fossil footprints.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: A woman from Thunder Junction who steals Arcavios artifacts through an Omenpath to sell on New Capenna.

entities.name: Dean Plargg
entities.description: Another dean at Strixhaven, who bends rules for amusement.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A former planeswalker who asked Quint's help with a discovery on Ixalan.

entities.name: The Coin Empire
entities.description: A mysterious empire that spanned planes and cultures for ages, vanished overnight and left coin motifs behind.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of history and archaeology, led by Dean Tullus.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: A Strixhaven college that Quint did not join.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders whose invasion left scars on Strixhaven.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A university on Arcavios, recovering from the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: A desolate battlefield on Arcavios where the dead relive the Blood Age battles.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Quint's home plane.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Saheeli's home plane, where Quint found coin motifs and a figure in a tank.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The home plane of Stella Lee.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane where Stella Lee has a buyer for Arcavios artifacts.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where Quint's research hit a dead end.

entities.name: Colony's End
entities.description: A place where Quint saw a preserved creature whose clawed hands match fossil tracks on Arcavios.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, where Quint finds coin motifs and which he grasps to escape a ghost.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Tunnels between planes, some visible only at the right angle, used by Stella Lee.

entities.name: The Blood Age
entities.description: A time of endless war whose dead still fight in the Fields of Strife.

events.summary: Quint returns to Arcavios by planeswalking onto the Strixhaven quad and heads for the Lorehold campus.
events.quote: In a flash of warm, radiant light and the sound of rustling paper, a loxodon appeared.

events.summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus's secretary that reports of his death were exaggerated and asks to see the dean.
events.quote: "Reports of my death or vaporization have been highly exaggerated

events.summary: Quint explains his search for a coin motif spanning planes, and Dean Tullus listens.
events.quote: the strange coin motif he had encountered there

events.summary: Quint reveals the Coin Empire vanished overnight and may have left something behind on Arcavios.
Quint persuades Dean Tullus to hire him as a temporary teaching assistant so he can join the Fields of Strife excursion.
events.quote: "No. I'm suggesting you hire me as a temporary teaching assistant.

events.summary: At the Fields of Strife base camp, Quint decides to commune with the dead of the Blood Age and steps through the protective wards.
events.quote: then turned and stepped intentionally through the protection wards.

events.summary: Quint relives a dead general's last memories and is warned by Tullus about losing himself in the fields.
events.quote: "If you're not careful, we can lose you to the fields,"

events.summary: Quint steps over the forbidden boundary line into the territory of the deep shades.
events.quote: Deliberately, not looking back, Quint stepped over the line.

events.summary: A warlord's memory overwhelms Quint; he grasps the Blind Eternities to pull free of the ghost.
events.quote: Firmly grasping the Blind Eternities, he pulled himself forward, through the ghost and into the open space beyond.

events.summary: Quint falls through a crust of stone into a sinkhole.
events.quote: sending him toppling down into the dark.

events.summary: Quint discovers a cache of Blood Age artifacts in the hidden chamber and takes a ceramic knife as proof.
events.quote: And he'd simply … fallen into a major historical find. Again.

events.summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus of the discovery, and she assigns the geomancer Mica to go with him.
Quint and Mica return to the cache and find objects moved and some missing.
Quint discovers Stella Lee packing the artifacts to take through an Omenpath for sale on New Capenna.
events.quote: I've got a buyer for old Arcavios artifacts over on New Capenna

events.summary: Quint summons ghostly echoes against Stella, who fights them off with a whip and escapes through the Omenpath.
events.quote: Stella Lee, moving fast now, leapt into the Omenpath and was gone

events.summary: Mica uncovers fossil footprints matching the creature from Colony's End and a mosaic of a tentacled horror, showing the Coin Empire reached Arcavios.
events.quote: The Coin Empire had definitely reached Arcavios.

relations.note: Quint is a Lorehold student whose advisor is Dean Tullus.
relations.quote: the direction that would eventually take him to the Lorehold campus

relations.note: She was Lorehold's dean of order.
relations.quote: Augusta Tullus had been Lorehold's dean of order

relations.note: Tullus is Quint's academic advisor, fond of him.
relations.quote: She had always been fond of him
Dean Augusta Tullus's secretary was a young owlin

relations.note: Quint drives off Stella Lee, who is looting the cache.
Mica helps Quint document the site.
relations.quote: Mica will help you document your findings

relations.note: Saheeli asked Quint's assistance with a discovery on Ixalan.
relations.quote: requested my assistance with a new discovery on her home plane of Ixalan
